name: russian-roulette-bar
description: Multiplayer cinematic bar roulette party game (server-authoritative, Three.js + cannon-es + ws)

scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.build:server: esbuild server/src/server.ts --bundle --platform=node --outfile=server/dist/server.js --format=esm --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.dev: npm run dev:client && npm run build:server && node server/dist/server.js
